lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-regular 2D grid posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect horizontal rows of spots to form a lattice-like arrangement of high-luminance nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges on the upper flank exhibiting a sharp luminance transition from light upper edges to shadowed lower boundaries.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, dark, circular indentation is visible on the mid-flank. An irregular notch is present on the posterior margin of the visible pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density distribution of small, randomly scattered high-luminance blobs, distinct from the structured grid on the main body flank.
